reference.question: Calculate the value of \(|-12|-|5|+|0|\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Evaluate each absolute value

\(|-12|=12\), \(|5|=5\), and \(|0|=0\), so \(12-5+0=7\).

nodes.description: Apply properties of operations as strategies to add and subtract rational numbers .

nodes.description: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions in such a way as to produce an equivalent sum or difference of fractions with like denominators. For example, 2/3 + 5/4 = 8/12 + 15/12 = 23/12. (In general, a/b + c/d = (ad + bc)/bd.)
nodes.label: 5.NF.A.1

nodes.description: Understand p + q as the number located a distance |q| from p, in the positive or negative direction depending on whether q is positive or negative. nodes.label: 7.NS.A.1b

nodes.description: Understand subtraction of rational numbers as adding the additive inverse , p – q = p + (–q). Show that the distance between two rational numbers on the number line is the absolute value of their difference, and apply this principle in real-world contexts.
nodes.label: 7.NS.A.1c
